title: Because the self-model is transparent, the system identifies with its content

statements.text: A large part of the human self-model is transparent: it cannot be experienced as a model, so the system fully identifies with its content. Because the conscious body model cannot be recognized as a model by introspection, people experience themselves as real, distinct, unified bodily selves.

sources.quote: because we are not able to experience it as a model and therefore fully identify with it representational content
because it cannot introspectively be recognized as a model, we fully identify with its representational content
